messages.content:
**Fixed, Darrin.**

The deprecation warning was caused by `normalize-package-data@6.0.2` (used transitively via `read-pkg@9.0.1`) which still used the deprecated `url.parse()` API.

**Changes made:**
- Updated `read-package-up` from `^11.0.0` to `^12.0.0` in `/home/atmandk/LowCal-dev/packages/cli/package.json`
- This pulls in `normalize-package-data@8.0.0`, which uses the WHATWG URL API instead

The main CLI now uses the modern URL API. The vscode-ide-companion package still depends on an older version via `npm-run-all@4.1.5`, but that's a separate concern and doesn't affect the core CLI functionality.

Run `npm install` to apply the changes (already done above).

**Fixed, Darrin.**

The deprecation warning was caused by `normalize-package-data@6.0.2` (used transitively via `read-pkg@9.0.1`) which still used the deprecated `url.parse()` API.

**Changes made:**
- Updated `read-package-up` from `^11.0.0` to `^12.0.0` in `/home/atmandk/LowCal-dev/packages/cli/package.json`
- This pulls in `normalize-package-data@8.0.0`, which uses the WHATWG URL API instead

The main CLI now uses the modern URL API. The vscode-ide-companion package still depends on an older version via `npm-run-all@4.1.5`, but that's a separate concern and doesn't affect the core CLI functionality.

Run `npm install` to apply the changes (already done above).
